svg.aria-label: Accountability: I write the ticket, approve the spec and own the merge. Independent review: Two models review each change. Both must approve before a PR opens. Release decisions by rule: A release check reads the merged PRs. Fixed rules give GO or HOLD. Local first: Image generation, document creation and code search run on my machine
